rules: CRITICAL: BANNED LIST - Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans or Lato for headings. Headings are Fraunces (font-serif). Inter Tight is the body face and is not covered by this.
Headlines (Size > 32px): MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels: MUST be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
H1 (Hero/Main Heading): MAXIMUM text-6xl (clamp/fluid scaling). Do not use text-7xl, text-8xl, or text-9xl.
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Load exactly one font stylesheet, the @import at the top of src/index.css. public/index.html must not load a second one.
typography.source_of_truth: tailwind.config.js and src/index.css. This file follows the code, not the other way round.

strategy: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000. Tint neutral greys with warm tones to complement Burnt Orange.
Avoid generic full-screen gradients (especially purple/blue). Use subtle noise/grain texture over gloss.
Primary Burnt Orange (#F05D14) should be used selectively for CTAs and critical accents, not background fills.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant): Use for Sticky Headers/Navs. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10 (1px delicate inner stroke).
Neumorphism (Tactile): Use for Dashboard Cards. Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift, subtle shadow, border brightens.
decorations: Textures: Apply subtle grain or noise overlays to break digital flatness.
Max Overlay Opacity for Hero Images: bg-black/50. If image isn't visible, overlay is too heavy. Prefer gradient overlay vs blanket flat overlay.

component_rules.forms_and_inputs: ALWAYS use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox (HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE them to strip the 'Vercel-look' via Tailwind).
component_rules.buttons: Modern styles. Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Interaction animations and color relevant to the app style.
component_rules.cards: Go cardless or sharp edges, rectangular, dense styles. Minimize rounded corners to max 8px (rounded-lg or rounded-md).
component_rules.navigation: MUST have a visible navigation bar on desktop with Logo, 3-5 links, and CTA. DO NOT use completely transparent background in header. Always use Glassmorphism or solid dark background.
component_rules.calendar_dropdowns: Use Shadcn calendar and dropdown-menu. DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>.

spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6, p-8) to prevent collision.
Tailwind Scale: Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32 for section padding.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_marketing: MODE A (Tetris Grid): Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave negative space.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_dashboard: MODE B (High Density Grid): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
alignment: Never center everything by default. Use explicit alignment and hierarchy. Left-align dense content and paragraphs.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

rules: Hover states (all interactive elements): explicit color shifts. E.g., hover:text-white hover:bg-orange-600.
DO NOT use universal transition (transition-all). Target specific properties: transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200.

contrast: When placing text over images/gradients, use text shadow to maintain contrast.
interaction: Focus states MUST have HIGHER contrast than default state.

images: Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh (max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none).
Include subjects in scenes for authenticity. Avoid empty, artificial scenes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file entirely and apply the specified font families in `index.css` and `tailwind.config.js`.
2. Setup 'Instrument Serif' for all h1, h2, h3 tags and 'DM Sans' for body text. Enforce tracking and leading rules.
3. Implement the dark mode color scheme. Override Shadcn default Vercel-like styling to match this premium cinematic aesthetic.
4. Build the placeholder Landing page using pure HTML/Tailwind, incorporating the provided images with proper dark gradient overlays.
5. Build the Signup page with Creator vs Brand role selection.
7. Build the Dashboard placeholder shell with a Sidebar/Nav layout, leveraging the Neumorphic tactile card rules.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and backdrop blurs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or over content.
